scope: This document contains 100 unique cardiovascular questions selected from 481 cardiovascular-tagged records imported from the NLM Clinical Questions Collection. It is a CLARA project compilation, not an official NLM publication or a clinically validated examination.

The National Library of Medicine (NLM, 2025) describes the collection as questions gathered from healthcare providers in clinical settings between 1991 and 2003. The collection is historical and is no longer expanded with new content.

Selection emphasized adult cardiovascular diagnosis, treatment, monitoring, prevention, and medication safety, with reduced repetition. This purposive selection is not a statistical sample or a validated ranking of clinical importance.

Question text uses the source general_question field when available, otherwise the original_question field. Only display whitespace is normalized. Each item includes its NLM ID and original collection record ID. The accompanying JSONL retains the original wording and archive provenance.
National Library of Medicine. (2025). Clinical Questions Collection [Data set]. Data.gov.
Source archive references and attribution details appear after Question 100.

Reference answers and evaluation scores are not included. CLARA responses will be reviewed using the answer relevancy rubric on the preceding page. Reference answers must be prepared from the relevant guideline PDFs and reviewed separately. Validation remains pending until the reviewer completes the final sign­off. Historical question wording is retained for traceability.

The Data.gov catalog identifies the dataset license as the Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Source attribution is retained; the selection and organization are specific to the CLARA project. Catalog and download links were checked on 2 November 2026.
The citations identify the origins of the questions. They are not clinical evidence supporting an answer. References for eventual evaluation answers must point to the actual guideline evidence used.
